events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine impact
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, John Lennon released his timeless album 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity still resonates. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Sting Turns 75
events.blurb: Today, musician, singer, and songwriter Sting, born Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner, celebrates his 75th birthday.

angles.name: Celebrate Sting
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Sting! From The Police to his solo career, what's your top Sting track?

events.title: The First iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple launched the device that changed how we listen to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global celebration of the James Bond film franchise, marking the premiere of Dr. No in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day tribute
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's enduring legacy on the anniversary of Dr. No's premiere. Which Bond theme song is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Today we remember John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's his most impactful song for you?

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Today, legendary British actor and comedian John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment from his incredible career?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. Its experimental sound broke new ground. What's your hidden gem from this iconic record?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991 and would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His incredible voice and stage presence are truly missed. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a pivotal shift in their sound. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day, we remember musician, activist, and peace advocate John Lennon, who passed away in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's lasting impact
angles.copy: Today marks the anniversary of John Lennon's passing. His music and message for peace continue to resonate globally. What's his most meaningful song to you?

events.title: David Bowie Would Have Been 80
events.blurb: Today we celebrate the life and legacy of David Bowie, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Bowie tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the iconic David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true innovator who constantly reinvented music and style. Which era of Bowie do you love most?

events.title: Elvis Presley Would Have Been 92
events.blurb: Today we celebrate the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 92.

angles.name: Elvis tribute
angles.copy: Long live the King! Celebrating Elvis Presley on what would have been his 92nd birthday. His music still moves generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page Turns 83
events.blurb: Today, legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the guitar maestro, Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock history. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track featuring his iconic sound?

events.title: Rod Stewart Turns 82
events.blurb: Today, the distinctive voice of Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod Stewart
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart! His career spans decades with countless hits. What's your go-to Rod Stewart song?

events.title: Suggs Turns 66
events.blurb: Today, Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Suggs
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness! From 'One Step Beyond' to 'Our House', what's your favourite Madness moment?

events.title: Paul Young Turns 71
events.blurb: Today, English singer Paul Young, known for his soulful voice and 80s hits, celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Paul Young
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the soulful Paul Young! 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' and 'Every Time You Go Away' are just a couple of his classics. Which one gets you singing along?
